definition: a guest or guests visiting someone
description: On a sunny city canal with red-brick warehouses and an arched bridge, a young man with curly hair in striped pyjamas and a grey cardigan stands on the back of a green narrowboat, frying eggs in a pan on a small blue camping stove. Young people climb and jump from a red narrowboat onto his boat with sunflowers, a guitar and a potted lemon tree, and a small white dog comes too. A crowd cheers on the red boat while a smiling woman with sunflowers stands next to him and he stares blankly.
